name: Fire Suppression Sprinkler Flow Rate
description: Water flow rate from a fire sprinkler head during activation. Checks whether flow meets fire safety standard.

elements.name: Sprinkler Discharge Flow Rate
elements.description: Flow rate from a single sprinkler head. Uncertain due to pipe pressure variation and head K-factor tolerances.

uncertainty.source: Hydraulic calculation with ±10% supply pressure variation

elements.name: Minimum Required Flow Rate
elements.description: EN 12845 minimum discharge density for OH1 occupancy

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(Q_sprinkler) = Q_sprinkler if Q_sprinkler >= Q_min, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The EN 12845 minimum discharge rate guards the sprinkler flow uncertainty set; only flow rates at or above 80 L/min satisfy the standard.
